status: Exploratory extension; written before this package's simulations, after reviewing historical full-rank results
purpose: Test the existing temporal watermark and common-G architecture under actual node-local unobservability
model: A4=block_diag(A2,A2), Q4=block_diag(Q2,Q2); even node i observes H2_i times first block, odd node i observes H2_i times second block
attack: Original six directed links and their original two-dimensional A0 channel-injection waveform, onset 50 and duration 60; no new optimization
detector: Original five-packet parity and four-residual Gaussian plugin-KL; valid on each sender's observable invariant 2-D subsystem; full-path calibration repeated for the new joint sensor law
gains: New four-dimensional common-G nominal DARE gains for all 57 node-local modes/model; historical 2-D gains and c=0.1 certificate are not reused
selector: No new parameter selection; three fixed candidates only
pairing: Same physical paths and CRN latent draws for all fixed candidates; separate calibration, healthy holdout, and attacked seed namespaces
metrics: network squared Euclidean error per node, not per coordinate
sender-observed and sender-missing state block error
reporting: Paired fixed-candidate differences, nominal 95% t intervals conditional on realized calibration; explicitly exploratory and not distribution-free certificates
limitations: Measurement dimension remains 2, so not an m>2 watermark experiment
Original attack waveform is reused rather than reoptimized for A4
